name: C-CPI-U
description: Chained CPI for All Urban Consumers, U.S. city average, all items, not seasonally adjusted (used by the Census Bureau for CPS ASEC income from 2000 onward)
method: annual average = mean of 12 monthly indexes, rounded to 3 decimals
note: Years with an unpublished month have no annual average in the CSV; see provisional.
revision_note: C-CPI-U values are preliminary when first published and are revised for about 10-12 months; years listed in preliminary_years contain preliminary months and will change.
